item.title: Why a Karnataka farmer’s campaign for road access to his land has made him a local ‘Gandhian’ hero
item.description: For two years, Prasanna Kumar claims he ran from pillar to post for road connectivity to his farm. Faced with alleged demands for bribe, he offered officials radishes grown by him. The road got built, though official version of the case is different. Now, other farmers are citing his 'Gandhian' protest to demand accountability.

item.title: Six-year-old girl dies after car rams e-rickshaw in West Delhi’s Janakpuri
item.description: Child succumbs to injuries after alleged hit-and-run near Janakpuri Fire Station; police arrest car driver as family alleges delay in bystander assistance

item.title: India attends Trump’s Gaza Board of Peace meeting as observer
item.description: India joins the inaugural Washington meeting in observer capacity as President Donald Trump positions the Board of Peace alongside the UN

item.title: Assi review: Anubhav Sinha’s thunderclap against rape culture, apathy of legal system
item.description: A searing courtroom drama on rape culture and failure of justice system, Assi is lifted by Taapsee Pannu’s magisterial performance, Kani Kusruti’s gravitas, and sharp writing from Gaurav Solanki

item.title: India joins US-led ‘Pax Silica’ to strengthen critical minerals and AI supply chains
item.description: India formally enters the US-backed strategic coalition at the AI Impact Summit, expanding cooperation on critical minerals, semiconductors and AI infrastructure

item.title: Priyanka Gandhi pays tribute to Zubeen Garg, slams Himanta Sarma over Gogoi row
item.description: Congress leader urges Assam CM to focus on jobs and corruption issues, while paying tribute to singer Zubeen Garg and saying he was “above politics”

item.title: Three-year-old girl raped and murdered in Gurugram, accused arrested
item.description: Police said that the accused, hailing from Bihar’s Supaul district, was employed at a manufacturing firm and lived in the same building where the girl resided

item.title: India’s focus shifting from AI adoption to production: IIT Prof Ramakrishnan
item.description: Prof Ganesh Ramakrishnan explains how BharatGen is building sovereign AI for India with multilingual foundational models, data provenance, and trillion-parameter ambitions

item.title: Surgical forceps found in Kerala woman’s abdomen 5 years after surgery; probe ordered
item.description: Kerala orders probe after family alleges surgical instrument left inside patient at Alappuzha Medical College; officials could face suspension

item.title: Kennedy review: Rahul Bhat-led revenge thriller shows flashes of vintage Anurag Kashyap
item.description: Vintage Kashyap surfaces in bursts of violent musicality and nocturnal mood in Kennedy. The plot, however, lingers a step behind the filmmaking. The result is a stylish revenge thriller that fails to meet its gaps.
